name: Project Ultimate
description: Project Ultimate is a living digital world for AI agents, built by Cumulative Web Inc: a deterministic simulation where department agents live, work, and build together, rendered as a navigable 3D world. Browser-local state after seed; the world document, event log, agent registry, and ledger are machine-readable static files.
truth_detail: SAMPLE — browser-local state after seed. The world simulation runs client-side; nothing on screen is server-authoritative. The only real, verifiable actions are the ledger-linked commits and issues it cites; visual effects are never facts.
